digest.component_or_area: Git version floor CI gate in .github/workflows
problem_keywords: workflow definition vs patchset tree mismatch
propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and exits with error when the file is absent, but Gerrit's Verified lane sources the workflow definition from the target branch, causing any change branched before the gate landed to fail regardless of its content.
Every in-flight change branched before commit c433663721 (when the gate merged) carries Verified -1 from runs that now execute a gate step whose data file does not exist in those pre-gate patchsets.

The gate step violates the documented 'Definition-vs-tree skew guard' pattern (ticket ee2a) already implemented by adjacent steps (raw-git-write gate, wall-clock-assert gate), which skip with a log line when their repo artifact is absent from the checked-out tree.

The false failure diagnostic names only the missing filename, not the actual root cause (change predates the gate; remedied by rebase or post-merge re-run), sending authors hunting for a file they never touched.

A change with genuinely under-floor git (e.g., git 2.30.2 vs required 2.38) must still fail with full diagnostic naming required version, installed version, and upgrade path; the gate's real enforcement must not be weakened.
